threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing page relays a payroll administrator's password and SMS code; attacker downloads the employee census report (SSNs, dates of birth, bank accounts) and changes associates' direct deposit accounts before Friday payroll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll service MFA uses SMS codes; no alerts on bank changes or report exports; no phishing training; any administrator can export every worker's SSN
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (payroll SMS codes; bank-change and export alerts off); EV-004 (any administrator can run the census report; 6 downloads in 2026); EV-027 (no phishing training); EV-040 (risk interviews)
existing_controls: Unique payroll logins; SMS codes; payroll limited to 3 administrators
treatment_plan: Authenticator-app MFA for payroll administrators; vendor alerts on bank changes and report exports to the Operations Manager and Owner; Owner's monthly review of the bank-change report; phishing training with a payroll scenario; census export limited to the Operations Manager

threat_event: Fraudster impersonates an associate by text, email, or phone, or takes over the associate's self-service account, and redirects that associate's pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff change bank accounts on request with no call-back; associate self-service bank changes need a password only; no alert to the firm
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (bank changes entered without a call-back); EV-003 (self-service bank change with a password only; no alert to the firm); EV-043 (Coordinator interview 2026-07-22)
existing_controls: Payroll service emails the associate after a bank change
treatment_plan: Written rule: no bank change by email or text; call-back to the phone number on file for every staff-entered change; ask the vendor to require a second factor for self-service bank changes; first payroll after a change held for review by the Operations Manager

threat_event: Business email compromise of a staff mailbox exposes SSNs, identity document photos, and consumer reports kept in email and the shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA without number matching; no phishing training; 63 messages with SSNs or ID images found in mailboxes; mailbox has access to the whole shared drive
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (push MFA with number matching off); EV-045 (63 messages with SSNs or ID images); EV-012 (whole drive shared with all staff); EV-027 (no phishing training)
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Turn on number matching; suite alerts for forwarding rules and mass downloads; delete or move the 63 messages; candidates upload documents only through the ATS link

threat_event: A staff member, or anyone using a staff account, opens or copies Form I-9 images and consumer reports in the shared Onboarding folder without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All 7 staff can open the whole shared drive, including 214 Form I-9 scan packets and 412 consumer report PDFs; no access review
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (Onboarding folder open to all 7 staff); EV-045 (214 Form I-9 scan packets and 412 consumer report PDFs); EV-030 (no access review records)
existing_controls: None (no folder permissions)
treatment_plan: Restrict the Onboarding folder to the Operations Manager and the Coordinator; move consumer reports out of the shared drive (the screening portal keeps them); quarterly access review

threat_event: Ransomware or a destructive attacker deletes or encrypts the shared drive and email, and the backup cannot restore it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sync client on laptops; backup never restore-tested; 30-day versions, not immutable; backup console login without MFA
likelihood_basis: EV-021 (no restore jobs; 30-day versions; immutable retention off); EV-012 (sync client on laptops); EV-044 (backup console login without MFA)
existing_controls: Daily suite backup; paper Forms I-9 are the record of retention
treatment_plan: MFA on the backup console; 90-day immutable versions; restore test by 2026-09-30, then quarterly

threat_event: A former staff member or a departed colleague's credentials are used to reach the ATS, email, payroll, or E-Verify
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations handled when remembered; former recruiter's ATS and email accounts active 2 months (disabled 2026-07-21); E-Verify outside every sign-in system
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (former recruiter's ATS and email accounts active 2 months); EV-034 (accounts removed when remembered); EV-013 (E-Verify outside every sign-in system)
existing_controls: Unique logins; MFA tied to the user's phone
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist covering ATS, payroll, suite, E-Verify, MFA registrations, and phones; monthly account reconciliation against the staff roster

threat_event: A lost or stolen personal phone exposes email, the ATS app, and candidate identity document photos in text threads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal phones unmanaged; no remote wipe; candidates text ID photos to recruiters
likelihood_basis: EV-034 (personal phones with no mobile management or remote wipe); EV-045 (candidate ID photos in text threads on 3 phones)
existing_controls: Phone passcodes (not enforced)
treatment_plan: Phone rules in POL-02 Part C (passcode, encryption, app protection, sign-out on loss); delete ID photos from text threads; candidates use the ATS upload link; report a lost phone within 1 hour

threat_event: After a breach the firm misses the Florida 30-day notice clocks or the immediate E-Verify notice to DHS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or notice procedure before 2026; nobody knew the clocks
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no incident plan or notice procedure); EV-043 (Owner and Operations Manager interviews 2026-07-21)
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3), (4), (9); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.16
existing_controls: Cyber insurance with breach counsel
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and notification matrix; notice templates; tabletop with the MSP

threat_event: The ATS AI match feature hides qualified applicants, with a disparate effect on women, older applicants, or applicants with Spanish-language resumes, and screens them out of referrals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Smart filter hid applicants scoring under 50 from 2026-03-16 to 2026-07-24 with no review, bias testing, notice, or accommodation path
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (smart filter on since 2026-03-16 with no other approval); EV-037 (no applicant notice of automated scoring); EV-042 (filter turned off 2026-07-24); EV-043 (Senior Recruiter interview 2026-07-23)
existing_controls: Smart filter turned off 2026-07-24
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: sort-only mode, recruiter review of every applicant who meets the job order's minimum requirements, quarterly bias test, applicant notice and accommodation path, vendor data terms

threat_event: The ATS AI subprocessor keeps or uses applicant data for its own model training, or suffers a breach the firm learns of late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Click-through AI terms allow model improvement use unless an opt-out is set (off); no breach notice term
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (AI terms allow model improvement use; no breach notice term); EV-008 (opt-out off)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Turn on the opt-out; data use addendum with deletion and breach notice terms (P10)

threat_event: The payroll service, or the firm's access to it, is unavailable on payroll Wednesday and associates are paid late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written manual payroll procedure; only two people can run payroll
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no written manual payroll procedure); EV-039 (off-cycle workaround never tried); EV-005 (Wednesday 5 p.m. cutoff)
existing_controls: Vendor's stated RTO 8 h; staff can work from home
treatment_plan: Written off-cycle payroll procedure; Owner trained as backup approver; drill once a year

threat_event: The single office internet line fails during business hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (one internet line, no failover); EV-039 (BIA interviews: staff can work from home)
existing_controls: Laptops and phone hotspots; staff can work from home; office line forwards to cell phones
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: phone hotspots and working from home cover a one-day outage

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP or its remote management tool reaches every laptop and the suite backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP agent on every laptop; MSP holds backup and firewall admin logins without MFA; no security terms or incident notice in the MSP contract
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (no security terms or incident notice in the MSP contract); EV-019 (MSP agent on every laptop); EV-044 (backup and firewall logins use a password only)
existing_controls: None beyond the MSP's own practices
treatment_plan: MFA on MSP-held logins; annual MSP security questionnaire with evidence; contract amendment with 24-hour incident notice, named technicians, and a recovery commitment

threat_event: An immigration inspection finds Forms I-9 that cannot be produced, are incomplete, or whose scanned images lack the required audit trail
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No index of paper Forms I-9; scans in the shared drive with no description of the system and 90-day logs; no internal I-9 self-check
affected_asset_or_process: Paper Form I-9 files; SYS-03; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (no index of paper Forms I-9); EV-030 (no written description of the scan process); EV-011 (90-day logs)
existing_controls: Paper originals in a locked cabinet
treatment_plan: Index of paper Forms I-9; short written description of the scan process; annual internal I-9 self-check of 20 files; decide whether to keep the scans at all

threat_event: Consumer reports, Form I-9 copies, and onboarding exports are kept for years past need and disposed of carelessly (old copier, retired laptops, scanner disk)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; paper Forms I-9 since 2017 never purged; consumer report PDFs since 2019; no wipe records
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no retention schedule); EV-046 (paper Forms I-9 since 2017); EV-045 (consumer report PDFs since 2019); EV-023 (no wipe records for retired laptops); EV-024 (copier returned 2024 with no wipe record)
existing_controls: Locked shred bin with certificates
treatment_plan: Retention schedule in POL-04; purge Forms I-9 past 3 years after hire or 1 year after termination, whichever is later; certified wiping for devices and the scanner disk

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report a phishing message, a lost phone, or a strange bank-change request quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training is a handbook acknowledgment only; no reporting rule
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (handbook acknowledgment only); EV-043 (staff interviews 2026-07-22)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Annual training, quarterly phishing simulations, and the 1-hour reporting rule in POL-03

threat_event: A breach at the ATS, screening provider, or payroll vendor exposes worker data and the firm learns too late to meet its own notice duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No breach notice terms in the ATS, screening, or MSP agreements; ATS vendor's SOC 2 report not received
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (no breach notice term; ATS SOC 2 report not on file); EV-014 (no breach notice term in the screening agreement); EV-018 (no incident notice clause in the MSP contract)
existing_controls: Florida law requires a third-party agent to notify within 10 days of its determination
treatment_plan: Vendor file with breach contacts; ask each vendor for 72-hour notice at renewal; obtain and review the ATS vendor's SOC 2 report

threat_event: An applicant is rejected based on a background check before receiving the FCRA pre-adverse notice, leading to an FCRA claim
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters see report results in the ATS and can release an assignment before the pre-adverse letter goes out; 2 such cases found in 2026
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (2 of 4 adverse decisions in 2026 before the pre-adverse letter); EV-014 (recruiters see report results in the ATS)
existing_controls: Provider sends pre-adverse and adverse letters with a 5-business-day wait
treatment_plan: Only the Coordinator sees report details; recruiters see 'in review' until the adverse action process ends; script for recruiters

threat_event: Someone uses the lobby applicant tablet to see other applicants' data or to plant malware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablet in kiosk mode on guest Wi-Fi; session clears on exit
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (kiosk mode on guest Wi-Fi; session clears on exit); EV-022 (guest Wi-Fi separated)
existing_controls: Kiosk mode; guest Wi-Fi; career site has no stored session
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: kiosk mode and guest Wi-Fi are sufficient

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; staff and associates are in the same metro area
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (no hurricane preparation steps); EV-010 (staff, clients and worksites in one metro area)
existing_controls: All core systems are SaaS; laptops go home before a storm
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: take laptops home, print the assignment roster, confirm client closures

threat_event: The scanner sends a scanned Form I-9 or onboarding form to the wrong email address, or its stored images are read later
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scan-to-email with free-text addresses; scanner keeps images on its internal disk
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (scan-to-email with free-text addresses; images kept on the scanner disk)
existing_controls: Scanner in the records room
treatment_plan: Scan-to-email limited to internal addresses; auto-erase of stored jobs turned on; disk wiped at lease end

threat_event: A former Coordinator's E-Verify user account is used by someone who knows the password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: E-Verify account of the Coordinator who left on 2025-12-12 was still active on 2026-08-11 (found in P07); password in a desk notebook
likelihood_basis: EV-AC-2 (former Coordinator's E-Verify account active, found in P07 testing); EV-046 (E-Verify passwords in a desk notebook)
existing_controls: E-Verify usage reports
treatment_plan: Account deactivated 2026-08-11; E-Verify user report showed no sign-in after 2025-12-10; process gap carried in R-006
